podcast.body: Released in 1978, "Lucky Number" was Lene Lovich's "fresh and fun hiccupy breakthrough single." Its distinctive and quirky sound made it a memorable hit. "Lena Loveach, with her fresh and fun hiccupy breakthrough single Lucky Number from 1978."

podcast.body: This "fresh and fun hiccupy breakthrough single" was released in 1978 and featured on Lene Lovich's album *Stateless*. "Lena Loveach, with her fresh and fun hiccupy breakthrough single Lucky Number from 1978, which leads me to Lena's friend Nina Hagen."
